in_arabic.name: دانياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name for a girl that is full of grace, beauty, and charm. It is derived from the Arabic root 'dunya', which means 'world'. The suffix 'iah' is added to denote femininity.

in_urdu.name: دانیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: A beautiful and radiant name for a girl. In Urdu, 'دانیہ' is derived from the Arabic root 'dunya' and means 'radiant, beautiful'. The suffix 'iah' is added to denote femininity.

in_hindi.name: दान्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name for a happy and contented girl. In Hindi, 'दान्या' is derived from the Arabic root 'dunya' and means 'happiness, contentment'. The suffix 'ia' is added to denote femininity.

in_pashto.name: دانيه
in_pashto.long_meaning: A beautiful and graceful name for a girl. In Pashto, 'دانيه' is derived from the Arabic root 'dunya' and means 'graceful, beautiful'. The suffix 'eh' is added to denote femininity.
